title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 66 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 66 - Income from other sources The following incomes of a taxpayer shall be classified and computed under the head of Income from other Sources, namely;- (a) income earned by way of royalty license fee, fee for technical know-how and grant of right to use intangible property; (b) cash subsidy provided by the Government; (c) income from any source not classified under any other head mentioned in section 30.
